name: match-stmt-type-narrowing-test-2f777af370/match-stmt-type-narrow-v.bal
spec_references: Statements → Match statement: Currently only supports const-pattern and wildcard-match-pattern
Expressions → Query expressions: Supports from, where, let, join (including outer join), order by, limit, on conflict and select clauses
reason: The asserted results depend on capture, list, mapping and error binding patterns in match clauses and narrowing through their guards, including narrowing the original matched value in subsequent clauses. These essential match patterns exceed the explicit const-pattern/wildcard-match-pattern restriction, so the whole case is a feature despite support for type tests and the query clauses used.
unsupported_constructs: Capture binding match patterns such as var a if a is int
List binding match patterns, including rest captures
Mapping binding match patterns, including rest captures
test_design_notes: Expected outputs exercise guarded matching and residual type narrowing, nested structural matching, singleton guards and query evaluation.
io:println is output instrumentation; toString method syntax is explicitly supported.
